annexures.title: Annexure 'A' — Identity Certificate for Government / PSU Employees
annexures.purpose: Mandatory for Central/State Government, PSU, and Autonomous Body employees.
annexures.template: This is to certify that Shri/Smt/Kum. {applicant_name} son/wife/daughter of Shri {father_name} who is an Indian citizen is an employee of this organization/office from {date_of_joining} and is currently holding the post of {designation}. There is no disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending against the applicant.

annexures.title: Annexure 'C' — Declaration by Parent/Guardian for Minor (Single Parent Consent)
annexures.purpose: When one parent has not given consent or is untraceable / legally separated.
annexures.template: I, {parent_name}, resident of {address} solemnly declare that I am the mother/father/guardian of minor child {child_name}. The other parent {other_parent_name} is unable to give consent due to {reason_for_no_consent}. I take full legal responsibility for the issuance of this passport.

annexures.title: Annexure 'D' — Standard Declaration of Parents for Minor Passport
annexures.purpose: Standard declaration signed by both parents/guardians for minor child's passport.
annexures.template: We, {father_name} and {mother_name}, residing at {address} hereby solemnly declare that we are the biological parents of minor {child_name} born on {dob} at {pob}. We hereby grant full consent for issuance of an Indian Passport to our minor child.

annexures.title: Annexure 'E' — Standard Self-Declaration for Tatkaal / Citizenship
annexures.purpose: Mandatory affidavit of Indian citizenship and no criminal record for all Tatkaal applications.
annexures.template: I, {applicant_name}, son/daughter of Shri {father_name}, born on {dob} at {pob}, residing at {address} under police jurisdiction of {police_station}, hereby solemnly declare that: 1. I am a citizen of India. 2. I have not been convicted of any criminal offense. 3. There are no warrants or summons pending against me.

annexures.title: Annexure 'F' — Specimen Affidavit for Lost / Damaged Passport
annexures.purpose: Affidavit describing circumstances of lost, stolen, or damaged passport with FIR copy.
annexures.template: I, {applicant_name}, son/daughter of {father_name}, residing at {address}, declare on oath that my previous passport bearing number {lost_passport_no} issued on {issue_date} at {issue_place} was lost/damaged on {incident_date} under the following circumstances: {incident_description}. A formal police report was lodged at {police_station} under FIR No. {fir_no} dated {fir_date}.

annexures.title: Annexure 'G' — No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Govt / PSU Employees
annexures.purpose: NOC issued by Head of Department / Controlling Authority for foreign travel.
annexures.template: The Ministry/Department/Office of {office_name} has No Objection to Shri/Smt {applicant_name}, working as {designation}, obtaining an ordinary Indian passport for private foreign travel.

annexures.title: Annexure 'H' — Prior Intimation (PI) Letter for Govt Employees
annexures.purpose: Prior formal intimation sent by employee to employer prior to passport application.
annexures.template: To {controlling_authority}, {department_name}. Subject: Prior Intimation for applying for Indian Passport. I, {applicant_name}, working as {designation} in {office_name}, hereby inform that I am applying for an ordinary Indian Passport.

annexures.title: Annexure 'I' — Declaration for Passport to Child Born via Surrogacy
annexures.purpose: Declaration by intending genetic parents for child born through surrogacy.
annexures.template: We, {father_name} and {mother_name}, residing at {address}, declare that the minor child {child_name} born on {dob} was born through surrogacy in compliance with Indian surrogacy regulations and ART guidelines.

annexures.title: Annexure 'J' — Joint Declaration in Lieu of Marriage Certificate
annexures.purpose: Affidavit by husband and wife declaring marriage without marriage certificate.
annexures.template: We, {husband_name} and {wife_name}, solemnly declare that we were married on {marriage_date} at {marriage_place} according to {marriage_customs} customs. We are living together as husband and wife at {joint_address}.

annexures.title: Annexure 'K' — Specimen Declaration for Change of Sex / Gender
annexures.purpose: Declaration by applicant along with medical certificate for sex change in passport.
annexures.template: I, {applicant_name}, residing at {address}, state that I have undergone gender transition surgery certified by {surgeon_name} of {hospital_name} on {surgery_date}, and request passport issuance under gender {new_gender}.

annexures.title: Annexure 'M' — Revocation of Power of Attorney / Authority
annexures.purpose: Declaration revoking authority given to any representative for passport submission.
annexures.template: I, {applicant_name}, hereby unconditionally revoke the authority previously granted to {agent_name} for my passport application file {file_no}.
